name: gossip_poll_events
description: Continuously poll or long-poll for updates, new messages, newly unblocked ready tasks, debate rounds, and peer activity with timeout

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the calling agent

auto_heartbeat.description: Automatically update agent's online heartbeat during poll (default: true)

current_task_id.description: Active task ID currently being worked on

role.description: Specialist role of the calling agent

timeout_seconds.description: Long-polling timeout in seconds (0 to 60; 0 returns immediately, >0 waits for events)
